mapper.select: SELECT FROM channel_payouts WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM channel_payouts WHERE status='PENDING' ORDER BY created_at,attempt_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_payouts SET status=IF(simulate_failure,'FAILED','SUCCEEDED'), resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),next_notify_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM channel_payouts WHERE status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') AND notified_at IS NULL AND next_notify_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_notify_at,attempt_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_payouts SET notified_at=IF(#{delivered},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),NULL), next_notify_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,5,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND notified_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM channel_payouts ORDER BY created_at DESC,attempt_id LIMIT 100
